answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and therefore paying the jade bond on all of them and exposing each to the river slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 3 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the violet audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Collateral of 41 dollars is at risk.
